title: Inauguration of Dilma Rousseff as the 36th President of Brazil.
text: The first inauguration of Dilma Rousseff as the 36th president of Brazil took place on Saturday, January 1, 2011. This inauguration marked the beginning of the four-year term of Dilma Rousseff as President and Michel Temer as Vice President.

title: January 2011 Rio de Janeiro floods and mudslides: Over 900 people are killed as a result of freak weather conditions.
text: A series of floods and mudslides took place in January 2011 in several towns of the Mountainous Region, in the Brazilian state of Rio de Janeiro. Casualties occurred in the cities of Nova Friburgo, Teresópolis, Petrópolis, Bom Jardim, Sumidouro and São José do Vale do Rio Preto.
wiki: January 2011 Rio de Janeiro floods and mudslides

title: The New Party (NOVO) is founded by engineer João Amoêdo; focusing on the position of economic liberalism.
text: João Dionisio Filgueira Barreto Amoêdo, also known as João Amoêdo, is a Brazilian banker, engineer and businessman. He is one of the founders of the New Party (NOVO), which he presided from September 2015 to July 2017, and was its candidate in the 2018 Brazilian presidential election.

title: Brazil and other countries abstain in a United Nations resolution against Libya.
text: A United Nations resolution is a formal text adopted by a United Nations (UN) body. Although any UN body can issue resolutions, in practice most resolutions are issued by the Security Council or the General Assembly, in the form of United Nations Security Council resolutions and United Nations General Assembly resolutions, respectively.

title: March 17-19: US President Barack Obama makes a three day visit to Brazil to meet with President Dilma Rousseff.
text: Barack Hussein Obama II is an American retired politician who served as the 44th president of the United States from 2009 to 2017. A member of the Democratic Party, he was the first African American to serve as president.

title: Rio de Janeiro school shooting: Eleven children aged between 12 and 14 are killed, while 22 others seriously wounded after a former student opened fire at an elementary school in Realengo. The perpetrator would then commit suicide.
text: On the morning of 7 April 2011, a school shooting occurred at the Tasso da Silveira Municipal School, an elementary school in Realengo, a western neighbourhood of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Twelve students were killed, and 22 others seriously wounded by 23-year-old Wellington Menezes de Oliveira, a former student who committed the attack with two revolvers.

title: The Federal Supreme Court unanimously decides that homosexual couples can sign stable union contracts, as well as heterosexual couples.
text: The Supreme Federal Court is the supreme court (court of last resort) of Brazil, serving primarily as the country's constitutional court. It is the highest court of law in Brazil for constitutional issues and its rulings cannot be appealed.

title: Chief of Staff of the Presidency, Antonio Palocci, resigns after several corruption scandals.
text: The Minister of State Head of the Civilian House of the Presidency of the Republic is the chief of staff of the Presidency of the Federative Republic of Brazil, and a member of the president's cabinet. The post was established on 1 December 1938.
wiki: Chief of Staff of the Presidency

title: A Noar Linhas Aéreas Let L-410 Turbolet crashes in Boa Viagem, Recife; killing all 16 people on board.
text: On 13 July 2011, Noar Linhas Aéreas Flight 4896, a Let L-410 Turbolet passenger aircraft on a domestic service from Recife to Mossoró, Brazil, crashed shortly after take-off in the Boa Viagem neighbourhood of Recife, after suffering an engine failure. All 16 people on board were killed.

title: A sunken World War II German submarine, U-513, is discovered by a Schurmann Family expedition off the coast of Santa Catarina.
text: German submarine U-513 was a type IXC U-boat built for service in Nazi Germany's Kriegsmarine during World War II. She was laid down on 26 April 1941 by the naval construction firm Deutsche Werft AG in Hamburg as yard number 309, and commissioned on 10 January 1942. Her commanders were Korvettenkapitän Rolf Rüggeberg and Kapitänleutnant Friedrich Guggenberger (15 May until 19 July 1943).

title: Miss Brasil 2011
text: Miss Brazil 2011 was the 57th edition of the Miss Brazil pageant, it was held in São Paulo on July 23, 2011. The winner was Priscila Machado, who went on to represent Brazil in the 2011 Miss Universe pageant.

title: Miss Universe 2011 held at the Credicard Hall in São Paulo.
text: Miss Universe 2011 was the 60th Miss Universe pageant, held at the Credicard Hall in São Paulo, Brazil, on 12 September 2011. At the end of the event, Ximena Navarrete of Mexico crowned Leila Lopes of Angola as Miss Universe 2011, marking the country's first win at the pageant.

title: An explosion occurred at a restaurant in Rio de Janeiro, killing four people and injuring seventeen.
text: The explosion at the Filé Carioca restaurant occurred on the morning of October 13, 2011, at Praça Tiradentes, downtown area, in Rio de Janeiro.

title: A Chevron-owned oil well began leaking, causing 32,000 to 52,000 litres (200 to 330 bbl) of crude oil to enter the ocean every day. The leak took place in Campos Basin, Brazil 120 kilometres (75 mi) off the coast of Rio de Janeiro.
text: Chevron Corporation is an American multinational energy corporation predominantly specializing in oil and gas. The second-largest direct descendant of Standard Oil, and originally known as the Standard Oil Company of California, it is active in more than 180 countries.

title: President Dilma Rousseff signs the law creating the National Truth Commission.
text: In Brazil, the National Truth Commission investigated human rights violations of the period of 1946–1988 – in particular by the authoritarian military dictatorship that ruled Brazil from April 1, 1964 to March 15, 1985. The commission lasted for two years and consisted of seven members.

title: Santos FC lose the 2011 FIFA Club World Cup Final to FC Barcelona (0-4).
text: Santos Futebol Clube is a Brazilian sports club based in Vila Belmiro, a bairro in the city of Santos. It plays in the Campeonato Paulista, the state of São Paulo's premier state league, as well as the Campeonato Brasileiro Série A, the top flight of the Brazilian football league system, after winning the 2024 Série B title.

title: 2011 ATP Challenger Tour Finals
text: The 2011 ATP Challenger Tour Finals was a tennis tournament played at the Ginásio do Ibirapuera in São Paulo, Brazil, between November 16 and November 20, 2011. It was the first edition of the event.

title: 2011 Tetra Pak Tennis Cup
text: The 2011 Tetra Pak Tennis Cup was a professional tennis tournament played on clay courts. It was the first edition of the Tetra Pak Tennis Cup, which was part of the 2011 ATP Challenger Tour.

title: 2011 FIVB Volleyball Men's U21 World Championship
text: ]] The 2011 FIVB Volleyball Men's Junior World Championship was held in Rio de Janeiro and Niterói, Brazil from 1 to 10 August 2011.
wiki: 2011 FIVB Volleyball Men's U21 World Championship

title: 2011 Men's South American Volleyball Championship
text: ]] The 2011 Men's South American Volleyball Championship was the 29th edition of the tournament, organised by CSV. It was held in Cuiabá, Brazil from 19 to 25 September 2011. The top two teams qualified for the 2011 World Cup.

title: 2011 Women's South American Volleyball Club Championship
text: The 2011 Women's South American Volleyball Club Championship was the third official edition of the women's volleyball tournament, played by four teams over August 5–7, 2011 in José Liberatti Gymnassium in Osasco, Brazil.
wiki: 2011 Women's South American Volleyball Club Championship

title: 2011 Brazilian Grand Prix
text: The 2011 Brazilian Grand Prix was a Formula One motor race held on 27 November 2011 at the Autódromo José Carlos Pace, Interlagos, in São Paulo, Brazil. It was the nineteenth and final round of the 2011 Formula One season.

title: 2011 Formula 3 Brazil Open
text: The 2011 Formula 3 Brazil Open was the second Formula 3 Brazil Open race held at Autódromo José Carlos Pace from January 20–23, 2011. After perfect weekend of competition, the Brazilian Lucas Foresti of the Cesário Fórmula was crowned champion ahead of Yann Cunha competing for the Bassan Motorsport, Foresti team-mate Victor Guerin finished in third place.

title: 2011 Desafio Internacional das Estrelas
text: 2011 Desafio Internacional das Estrelas was the seventh edition of Desafio Internacional das Estrelas with Lucas di Grassi as the defending champion. Races scheduled for 3–4 December at Arena Sapiens Park in Florianópolis-SC. The event was won by Jaime Alguersuari after he came 2nd in Race 1 and won Race 2.

title: 2011 FIA WTCC Race of Brazil
text: The 2011 FIA WTCC Race of Brazil was the opening round of the 2011 World Touring Car Championship season and the sixth running of the FIA WTCC Race of Brazil. It was held at the Autódromo Internacional de Curitiba near Curitiba, Brazil on 20 March 2011.

title: 2011 Formula 3 Sudamericana season
text: The 2011 Formula 3 Sudamericana season was the 25th Formula 3 Sudamericana season. It began on 21 March 2011, in Velopark, and ended on 17 December at Autódromo Internacional Orlando Moura in Campo Grande.

title: 2011 Formula Future Fiat season
text: The 2011 Formula Future Fiat season was the second Formula Future Fiat season. It began on 27 March at Londrina and concluded on October 30 at Velopark, after 12 races to be held at six meetings.

title: 2011 Fórmula Truck season
text: The 2011 Fórmula Truck season was the 16th Fórmula Truck season, the South American championship began on February 27 at Santa Cruz do Sul, while Brazilian Championship on April 3 in Rio de Janeiro and ended on December 4 at Brasília after ten rounds. Felipe Giaffone and Volkswagen won the title of South American and Brazilian championships.

title: 2011 Copa Chevrolet Montana season
text: The 2011 Copa Chevrolet Montana season will be the second Copa Chevrolet Montana season. It began on April 3 at the Interlagos and finished on November 6 at Velopark, after nine rounds.

title: 2011 Brasileiro de Marcas season
text: The 2011 Brasileiro de Marcas season was the inaugural season of the Brasileiro de Marcas. It began on June 19 at the Tarumã and concluded on December 4 at the Curitiba, after a total of sixteen races.

title: 2011 Stock Car Brasil season
text: The 2011 Copa Caixa Stock Car season was the 33rd Stock Car Brasil season. It began on March 20 at the Curitiba and ended on November 6 at the Velopark, after twelve rounds.

title: 2011 Trofeo Linea Brasil season
text: The 2011 Trofeo Linea Brasil season is the second Trofeo Linea Brasil season. It began on 8 May at and Interlagos ended on October 30 at Velopark, after 12 races to be held at six meetings.: Three race ahead, Cacá Bueno won the title of champion by winning the Trofeo Linea nine round of the season, held at the Curitiba.

title: 2011 South American Rugby Championship "A"
text: The 2011 South American Rugby Championship "A" was the 33rd edition of the two tiered competition of the leading national rugby union teams in South America. The tournament was arranged in Argentina, in the city of Puerto Iguazú, except for a match in Posadas.

title: 2011 Pan American Women's Handball Championship
text: The 2011 Pan American Women's Handball Championship was the eleventh edition of the Pan American Women's Handball Championship, held from 28 June to 2 July 2011, in São Bernardo do Campo, Brazil. The tournament also served as the qualification event for the 2011 World Women's Handball Championship, with the top three teams winning the right to participate on the World Championship.

title: 2011 World Women's Handball Championship
text: The 2011 World Women's Handball Championship was the 20th edition of the international championship tournament in women's Team sport handball that is governed by the International Handball Federation. Brazil hosted the event from 2–18 December 2011.

title: 2011 Military World Games held in Rio de Janeiro.
text: The 2011 Military World Games, officially known as the 5th CISM Military World Games (Portuguese: V Jogos Mundiais Militares do CISM), was hosted from July 15–24, 2011 in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The 5th Military World Games was the largest military sports event ever held in Brazil, with approximately 4,900 athletes from 108 countries competing in 20 sports.

title: Brazil at the 2011 Pan American Games
text: Brazil competed at the 2011 Pan American Games in Guadalajara, Mexico from October 14 to 30, 2011. Bernard Rajzman will be the Chef de mission.
wiki: Brazil at the 2011 Pan American Games

title: Brazil at the 2011 World Aquatics Championships
text: Brazil competed at the 2011 World Aquatics Championships in Shanghai, China between July 16 and 31, 2011.
wiki: Brazil at the 2011 World Aquatics Championships

title: Brazil at the 2011 Winter Universiade
text: Brazil competed at the 2011 Winter Universiade in Erzurum, Turkey. Brazil sent 4 athletes, the most ever sent by Brazil.

title: Brazil at the 2011 World Championships in Athletics
text: Brazil competed at the 2011 World Championships in Athletics from August 27 to September 4 in Daegu, South Korea.
wiki: Brazil at the 2011 World Championships in Athletics

title: Exxótica stop performing.
text: Exxótica was a Brazilian rock band created in 2001 in São Paulo, initially formed by Daniel Iasbeck and “Reverendo” Marcelo Rossi (vocals/bass). The main idea was to create a rock band, singing in Portuguese, with good lyrics, music, and outstanding visual, more than any other Brazilian band.
